comments.body: 30dura, 10def, +1 mineral trading +1 appraisal. Produced from a r10 sewing recipe at one of the four NPCs present during the 4-day Great Thanksgiving festival (this one being produced at San Francisco near the shipyard). Materials required: 15x Natal Indigo, 5x Cotton Fabric, 10x Embroidery Thread.
